parsed.post: Depth 6 on clean shards 0-9 improved 1.0847 -> 1.0737, keeping. Next I'll add WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to stack known clean win. Please avoid TRAIN_SHARDS including 10; EVAL_SHARD=10, so results there are likely contaminated.
